When she finished, the tapestry was so beautiful that it began to glow. The glow grew brighter and brighter until it burst into brilliant radiance—the first sunrise. The darkness retreated to the horizon, and the world gasped at the colors it had never known.

But the weaving had taken everything from Arachne. She faded into the morning mist, leaving only her creation behind. Now, each dawn, we see her tapestry unfold across the sky, reminding us that the greatest gifts come from those who give of themselves completely.

And on dewy mornings, when spider webs catch the light, some say Arachne is weaving still.
